sample_instructions_verified: In a large pot, bring salted water to a boil. Once boiling, add spaghetti and cook for 8-10 minutes until al dente.
While the pasta cooks, chop the cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, zucchini, and asparagus into bite-sized pieces.
In a large skillet over medium heat, add the olive oil. Once the oil shimmers (about 1 minute), add the garlic. Sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Continue by adding the bell peppers and asparagus to the skillet. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the peppers begin to soften.
Add the zucchini and cherry tomatoes to the skillet. Sauté for another 3-5 minutes until the vegetables are vibrant and tender.
